text: Import notes from Apple Notes (HTML), Evernote (ENEX), Markdown files, Roam (JSON) and Workflowy (OPML)
quote:
We currently support imports from:

*   Apple Notes (HTML)
*   Evernote (ENEX)
*   Markdown files
*   Roam (JSON)
*   Workflowy (OPML)

text: Apple Notes can be migrated by exporting them with a provided script and then importing into Reflect
quote: First you’ll have to export your existing Apple Notes using the provided script below, then import them into Reflect normally.

text: Export your notes at any time into open formats such as HTML or Markdown
quote: you can always export it into an open format (like HTML or Markdown).

text: API authentication uses OAuth 2 with PKCE support, so clients can be built without shipping secret keys
quote: For authentication, we support OAuth 2. You will need to create credentials here... We do support OAuth's PKCE extension

text: API access is controlled by OAuth2 scopes that separate read access (read:graph) from write access (write:graph)
quote: Reflect's full API reference is published as an OpenAPI package on openpm, linked from the vendor docs ("For a full list of API endpoints, see our documentation on openpm here" — reflect.academy/api): machine-readable spec at openpm.ai/pack

text: Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec for the Reflect API is published on openpm
quote: Reflect's full API reference is published as an OpenAPI package on openpm, linked from the vendor docs ("For a full list of API endpoints, see our documentation on openpm here" — reflect.academy/api): machine-readable spec at openpm.ai/pack

text: Public API supports appending data to notes and returning a list of bookmarked links
quote: Our supports appending data to your notes, returning a list of the links you've bookmarked, and a few other things.

text: API endpoints let you append to the daily note and create new notes
quote: Appends to daily noteput ... Creates a new notepost

text: Deep linking via a reflect:// custom URL scheme lets you run in-app commands with parameters, such as appending text to today's daily note
quote: reflect://reflect?command=<command_name>&<parameter1>=<value1>&...

text: Link notes together with the [[ shortcut and see backlinks, the list of incoming links from other notes
quote: Networked note-taking tools, like Reflect, support creating links between notes... backlinks

text: Linking to a note that does not exist yet creates that note automatically
quote: If you link a note that doesn't already yet exist, it'll be auto-created.

text: A new daily note is created automatically every day for journaling
quote: Tools like Reflect will create a new daily note for you everyday for you to journal in.

text: Filter notes by creation or update date, daily notes, backlinks, #tags and pinned status, and combine as many filters as needed
quote:
You can filter notes by:

*   Date created or updated
*   Daily Notes
*   Where they are backlinked to/from
*   #tags
*   Pinned notes

text: Semantic search finds information without needing the exact words
quote: Reflect's Semantic search lets you find specific pieces of information without knowing the exact words.

text: Chat with a filtered set of notes to ask questions and extract information
quote: After applying any desired filters to the search, you can also "chat" with those specific notes to ask questions and extract information.

text: Ask questions of your notes and get answers that link back to the source notes
quote: Ask your notes. Answers linked to source notes.

text: AI palette (cmd/ctrl+J on highlighted text) offers about a dozen prompts, such as listing key takeaways or action items
quote: To use it, first highlight some text, and then press `cmd j`... You can select from one of our dozen or so prompts, like ‘list key takeaways’ or ‘list action-items’.

text: Ask the AI palette anything in free text and save it as a reusable custom prompt
quote: You can also ask the AI palette anything you'd like using the open text field, and save it as a custom prompt to quickly call on again later.

text: Choose GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet as the model behind the AI tools, toggled in preferences
quote: Reflect's AI tools give you the option to now use either GPT-4o (the latest model from OpenAI) or Claude 3.5 Sonnet (the latest model from Anthropic). You can toggle between these in your preferences.

text: Connect your own LLM API key, with AI requests sent directly to your provider
quote: Connect your own API key to get started. Requests go directly to your provider.

text: Notes marked private are excluded from AI features
quote: Notes marked private are excluded from AI note

text: Note edits are recorded continuously, so you can view all changes and revert a note to any point in time
quote: We continually record edits to notes which means you can see all your changes and revert a note to any point in time.

text: One-click publishing makes a note publicly available at a long, hard-to-guess URL
quote: Reflect offers one-click publishing of your notes. Simply hit the publish button and your note will be publicly available behind a long hard-to-guess url.

text: Note contents are end-to-end encrypted, so no one else, including the vendor, can read them
quote:
The contents of your notes are end-to-end  
encrypted. No one else can read them  
(not even us).

text: Automatically sync Kindle books, highlights and comments as individual notes tagged #book, with authors back-linked
quote: Reflect can automatically sync your books, highlights, and comments from your Kindle. They will be imported into Reflect as individual notes, tagged as #book and the authors back-linked.

text: Built-in voice transcription uses Whisper, with near human-level accuracy
quote: Reflect has a state of the art voice transcriber through a technology called Whisper. It has near human-level accuracy

text: Recorded voice notes are uploaded and transcribed in the background, then added to your daily note
quote: Your note will be uploaded and then transcribed in the background. After a few minutes their transcription will be added to your daily note.

text: iOS lock screen widget starts an audio memo with one tap
quote: Our iOS has a lock screen widget that lets you start taking an audio memo with one tap.

text: Chrome and Safari extensions bookmark websites and capture snippets from across the web
quote: Reflect lets you quickly bookmark websites and capture snippets from across the web using our Chrome extension and Safari extension.

text: Clipped links and highlights are automatically added to your daily note
quote: The link and your highlights will automatically be added to your daily note.

text: Connect Google, iCloud or Office 365 calendars to pull events into daily notes
quote: We support connecting your Google, iCloud and Office 365 account(s) to Reflect. This lets you: Pull in your calendar events, so you can easily add meetings to your daily notes.

text: Zapier integration connects Reflect with other apps without coding
quote: Zapier is a tool that lets you connect apps via APIs, without doing any coding. You can use it to connect Reflect with other apps.

text: Bring in Trello cards, Asana tasks, Google Docs, Slack notes, emails, tweets and Strava data
quote: Add Trello cards or Asana tasks to your Daily Note Add Google Docs and Slack notes to Reflect Save emails and Tweets to your notes Sync your Strava data with Reflect

text: Note-taking app with daily notes, backlinks and local Markdown files
quote: An open-source note-taking app with daily notes, backlinks, and local Markdown files.

text: Source code is open and available on GitHub
quote: Open source. Explore the code on GitHub.

text: Choose iCloud Drive or Git to sync your notes
quote: Your choice of sync. Use iCloud Drive or Git.
